intro: thanks for looking after the menagerie. tap any card for the full briefing.

house_notes.title: Important locations
items: All dog and cat food lives in the kitchen side closet — senior dry, high-protein dry, large-dog dry, wet food cans, plus the measuring cups (sitting on top of the wet food).
Ziggy's meds + gloves live on the kitchen counter.
Cat free-feed bowls are in the downstairs bathroom.
Cabbage's eating spot is her shelf near the CDs (not a bowl).

house_notes.title: Feeding quirks
items: Wet dog food split: half to Ziggy, half to Lucy, with a quarter of Lucy's half going to Bear.
Pour Cabbage's food onto her shelf — Bear loves cleaning up after her.
Finn + Ellie free-feed all day; just keep the downstairs bathroom bowls topped up from the closet.

house_notes.title: Watch-outs
items: Ziggy needs one pill twice a day, plus a fish oil capsule in the evening.
Raccoons have been around — double-check the chicken shed is closed by sundown (Colin usually puts everyone to bed, but verify).

event: Ziggy's morning pill — wrapped in cheese.
Bear & Lucy get a little cheese too if they're nearby.

day_timeline.event: Dogs out for the toilet, then back inside.
Dogs usually want a second outdoor session.
Chicken roll-call — confirm all 9 are tucked into the shed.
Pre-dinner outside session for Ziggy & Lucy

event: Hide Ziggy's evening pill inside his wet food.

pets.name: Bear
pets.tagline: old man. couch enthusiast. very small.

feeding.where: Under the plants near the piano
feeding.what: 1/4 bowl senior dry food (kitchen side closet) + a small dollop of wet food — about a quarter of Lucy's half of the can.
feeding.notes: Needs to go outside for the toilet right after eating.

quirks: Loves sitting outside with Lucy to relax.
Will happily clean up after Cabbage when she eats off her shelf.

pets.name: Lucy

feeding.where: Kitchen side closet for food; usual dog feeding spot
feeding.what: About 1/2 bowl high-protein dry food + half a can of wet food on top.
feeding.notes: Wet can splits: Ziggy gets half, Lucy gets half, Bear gets a quarter of Lucy's half.

quirks: Might bark a little when you first arrive — she's a lover underneath.
A bit afraid of strange men, but warms up quickly.
Loves chilling outside with Bear.

pets.name: Ziggy
pets.tagline: world's largest lap dog. sensitive soul.

feeding.where: Kitchen — dry food and wet food in the side closet
feeding.what: A full big bowl of large-dog dry food + half a can of wet food on top (evening). The evening pill goes pushed into the wet food. He also gets a fish oil capsule in the evening.
feeding.notes: Half the wet can is Ziggy's; the other half splits between Lucy and Bear.

meds.schedule: One pill twice a day (morning + evening)
meds.location: Kitchen counter (gloves also on the counter)
meds.morning: Wrap pill in cheese. Bear and Lucy get a little cheese too if they're around.
meds.evening: Push pill into his wet food to hide it. Also give a fish oil capsule.

quirks: Sometimes scared to go outside — be patient.
Terrified of storms. Scratching his butt calms him down.

pets.name: Boomba

feeding.when: Twice daily — 8:00–10:00 AM and around 6:30 PM
feeding.what: Morning: slightly LARGER plastic cup. Evening: slightly SMALLER plastic cup. Both cups sit on top of the wet dog food in the side closet.
feeding.notes: He will demand food and try to trick you into feeding him more. Don't fall for it.

quirks: If you sit, he will sit on you.
Loud purring while sitting on you = he's about to bite. You have been warned.
Ignore him a bit and he gets snuggly. Pat him too much and he bites.
Mostly bites people who like cats.
warnings: may try to dart outside — he's fast
if he escapes, he hides under the deck (he doesn't go far)

pets.name: Finn

feeding.where: Downstairs bathroom — shares two bowls with Cabbage/Ellie
feeding.what: Dry cat food, kept topped up

quirks: Will run into any open door.
Sometimes gets himself trapped inside cupboards or stuck outside.
Pure love muffin energy.
warnings: watch open doors — he goes through them all

pets.name: Ellie

feeding.where: Downstairs bathroom — two bowls shared with Finn
feeding.what: Dry cat food, kept topped up

quirks: Spends most of her time upstairs unless she's in the mood to bully Cabbage.
Ragdoll-ish but prefers riding on your shoulder over being carried.
Confident and playful.
warnings: may bully Cabbage — give Cabbage space if Ellie is around

pets.name: Cabbage

feeding.when: Twice daily — 8:00–10:00 AM and around 6:30 PM
feeding.where: On her shelf near the CDs (NOT a bowl)
feeding.what: Small plastic cup of dry food (cups live on top of the wet dog food in the side closet).
feeding.notes: Pour carefully onto her shelf. The dogs (Bear especially) will hoover up anything that falls — this is expected and welcomed by all parties.

quirks: Likes her chair and her shelf. Otherwise prefers to be left alone.
Does not like being picked up by strangers.
warnings: can be bullied by Ellie — keep an eye on their interactions

pets.name: The Hens

feeding.what: A full bowl of laying pellets + two bowls of cracked corn.
feeding.notes: Water is automated — just glance at it to confirm it's flowing.

quirks: 9 hens total, including Colin the rooster.
Fat Face (the black one) and Karen (the pure white one) might escape — toss extra food in, open the door, and chase them back in.
Colin does a great job putting everyone to bed.
warnings: raccoons have been around — confirm the whole flock is in the shed by sundown
automated door usually closes itself, but verify

pets.name: The Roosters

feeding.where: Winter house (their summer house in the dog yard isn't ready yet)
feeding.what: Food and water topped up; should last fine for the trip.

quirks: Priscilla is the small fancy one. Alta Vista is the large black one.
Mostly chill, will go crazy if they see a hen.
Priscilla might try to bite. But Priscilla is very small.
warnings: if you go inside their house, Priscilla (the small one) will try to escape — block the door
